scope: Complete official component navigation at the fixed commit, cross-checked with MDX, source registry, generated registry and tree

countPolicy.documented: Each unique official /docs/components/ navigation leaf is counted once; demo variants are not added to this count.
countPolicy.registryUi: 154 registry:ui rows contain 17 explicitly deprecated aliases with no source files; canonical UI rows total 137.
countPolicy.examples: 153 registry:component rows are example entries, including 17 deprecated example aliases. Example count is not a count of independent effects.
countPolicy.variants: Variants, compound API parts and export functions inside one component are not independently counted; their total is not claimed.
countPolicy.blocks: registry/blocks.ts declares one authentication block, but registry/index.ts includes only ui and examples and public/r/registry.json contains zero registry:block entries. Blocks and external paid/AI SDK Agent patterns are excluded.
countPolicy.marketing: The README statement 150+ is retained as an upstream marketing statement and is not used as the documented component count.
